pages.text: $(li)$(l)Wizards$(): Arcane, Fire, Frost.$(li)$(l)Elemental mages$(): Water, Earth, Wind.$(li)$(l)Paladin$(): holy plate, maces, shields.$(li)$(l)Priest$(): healer with holy wands.$(li)$(l)Rogue$(): daggers and stealth.$(li)$(l)Warrior$(): double axes and glaives.

$(li)$(l)Berserker$(): heavy axes and fury.$(li)$(l)Forcemaster$(): fists and force.$(li)$(l)Archers$(): Archer, Deadeye, Tundra Hunter, War Archer.$(li)$(l)Witcher$(): sword fighting (Blade) or signs (Signs).$(li)$(l)Bard$(): songs that help the group, lutes and rapiers.
